_note: W0.1/W0.7 Phase 0 spike: scheduledTasks.upsert reply for a webhook task with signature {header, encoding, prefix, secret}. The reply echoes only header, encoding and prefix, and the task row shows hasSecret true; the secret is not returned. Probes: correct HMAC over the exact bytes -> 202 accepted, the same JSON re-encoded with a space and the old signature -> 401 rejected_signature, so the check needs the raw bytes byte for byte. Captured live 2026-11-12; task deleted afterwards.
